note: The knowledge base's eval set (ticket 21; spec, The eval). Kept apart from the frozen Port file, questions.json, and never blended with it. Written before any search ran, so the gold cannot be fitted to results. Gold comes from the dataset folder backend/data/datasets/default: chunk IDs from the corpus as a fresh build names them, record IDs from org/*.csv, S6's radius and paths from truth.json. The gold items choose the checks (review ruling 2): chunks get the two retrieval checks, records and paths the graph gate. 'verdict' is the search tool's expected verdict (none, weak, found); 'conclusion' is the investigator's expected conclusion for a benign twin. tests/test_eval_knowledge_base_questions.py checks every gold ID exists.
